SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'preopen' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS preopen, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'preaward' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS preaward, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'exception' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exception FROM tb_purchase_ledger
AND ( org_id = #{scopeId} OR org_id IN ( SELECT t.thrid_dept_id FROM sys_dept t WHERE FIND_IN_SET( (SELECT dept_id FROM sys_dept WHERE thrid_dept_id = #{scopeId}), t.ancestors) ) )

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(gk_num), 0) AS gkNum, IFNULL(SUM(yq_num), 0) AS yqNum, IFNULL(SUM(xj_num), 0) AS xjNum, IFNULL(SUM(dy_num), 0) AS dyNum, IFNULL(SUM(cg_num), 0) AS cgNum FROM tb_bid_report
project_department_id IS NOT NULL
AND ( project_department_id = #{scopeId} OR project_department_id IN ( SELECT t.thrid_dept_id FROM sys_dept t WHERE FIND_IN_SET( (SELECT dept_id FROM sys_dept WHERE thrid_dept_id = #{scopeId}), t.ancestors) ) )

SELECT vendor_name AS vendorName, SUM(contract_amount) AS contractAmount FROM tb_vendor_report
AND ( party_a_org_id = #{scopeId} OR party_a_org_id IN ( SELECT t.thrid_dept_id FROM sys_dept t WHERE FIND_IN_SET( (SELECT dept_id FROM sys_dept WHERE thrid_dept_id = #{scopeId}), t.ancestors) ) )
GROUP BY vendor_name ORDER BY SUM(contract_amount) DESC LIMIT 5
